subject: Human Body
title: Puberty and Sex Hormones
description: A 60-second lesson on Puberty and Sex Hormones.

hook.text: Around age 10–12, a hormonal switch flips. The hypothalamus starts pulsing GnRH and puberty begins.

buildup.text: GnRH triggers the pituitary to release LH and FSH. These stimulate the ovaries or testes to produce sex hormones.

discovery.text: Estrogen drives breast development and menstrual cycles. Testosterone drives muscle growth and voice deepening.

twist.text: Puberty timing is shifting. Better nutrition has lowered the average onset age by 3–4 years over the past century.

climax.text: Puberty is a hormonal cascade. One signal triggers another in a chain that transforms the body over several years.

punchline.text: One brain signal starts a chain that rewires the entire body.
